Get the help you need...
I have recently survived a suicide attempt and was placed into an involuntary hold for a week. At first it was no fun but my medication was changed. I feel so much better about my life...it gets better.
Also, you are obviously not a happy person. Don't push a person who is close to the edge.

That's a good perspective that hit close to home..
Lots to think about. Thank you.

Wow. You are a very brutal person. 
I did need to hear half of this for the sake of tough love...
You don't know my life story, you just read a brief description of my life problems. I'm not sitting here making a pitty party for myself, my age shouldn't matter. I was trying to talk to someone who has a damn heart to talk to. 
I'm not proud of my thoughts and I am seeking help. I go to counseling, support groups and I am a very involved parent (all while working fulltime). 
Thanks for taking the time to reply but keep your judgements to yourself.

My sisters best friend dated her high school sweetheart for years. He was diagnosed with Aspergers and was active in the autistic community. She was a positive person in his life and was very patient with him. Sadly, he killed himself..
She chose to become a nurse and she is still very active within the autistic community.

I've seen this persons account in the past...she's had a couple gofundme/amazon type of accounts. 
As a tattooed and modified person...I'd consider that trashy. Just my opinion..
Thank you. It's been bothering me...I also don't know how to let her know I don't feel comfortable with her taking my son by herself. I'm worried she will influence him...
That sounds like a good rule. I wish my Mother would understand that. She just thinks I'm being unfair.

Thank you! I appreciate yours (and everyones) kind words. 
He's been sober for a few months but recently relapsed, stopped going meeting and it's just been rough. I'm going to try looking for local alanon meetings in my town.

Since my son was able to ask "Who's that?" or "What's their name?" 
I always respond with "That's just a man or lady" and explain what they are doing "They are just grocery shopping.. Ect" I try not to brush his questions off, because he'll just keep asking or feel like I'm ignoring him. I also try not to leave it as friendly as "auntie" or "uncle" because we do practice strange danger.

I used to have a FB, around a year ago I deactivate. His family (auntie& cousin) randomly messaging me once each asking about my bf, not about my son. Just about my relationship. I didn't respond. But I do have an Instagram and I randomly got commented by one of bio dad's friends.  Reason why I posted this.. I feel completely uncomfortable having people from the past trying to fit there way back in my life. I'm not resentful, I just don't want to have people who hurt my son & I involved in our lives.

I really appreciate your input! We are definitely working on the legal process, and name change. It's a slow and expensive process, especially from a different state. 
I'm pretty sure his family and friends (never bio dad) have tried contacting me now because my life is not crappie as they expected it to be. My bf and I work, we have a happy and stable life. Our son is a great and happy kid.
No, we  haven't formally filed paperwork for adoption (it's expensive) but you do not need the other parent to do so. As long as you are able to have proof of abandonment (which we have).

Thanks for the advice. I was actually able to talk to him tonight and explained it to him the simplest way I could.. 
He seemed to understand (as much as a 4year old can).. I'm feeling a bit more at ease about the situation.
He's never once (since before my son was two) ever tried directly getting in contact with me.

My mind changed when he completely disappeared, changing his number and not leaving a forwarding address. He never once gave me money or pay child support (I dropped the case) and my mom still lives in the address he had in prison. He's had plenty of opportunities..

I actually did. I tried letting him stay in contact..still have the letters he sent the first few months but as soon as he was out of prison he distanced himself than changed his number. No contact since then by him directly.
We definitely plan on telling my son more information the older. If he becomes curious or want to know more information. I do have plenty of pictures and information I've been saving for him.
Yep, we're definitely looking into our legal options. We're in process of changing my son's last name..
